title: UI kit staged tests require executable CWD
body: test_ui_kit assets are resolved relative to the process working directory, so invoking the built test from the repository root failed asset setup and crashed; the witness had to cd to .tmp/build/wsl-debug/libraries/RenderGraph/tests. Make test assets locate relative to the binary or test root.

title: SVO material table has no shared JSON dependency
body: RuntimeMaterialTable initially could not include nlohmann/json.hpp in the SVO target even though the dependency is available elsewhere; the implementation had to hand-parse content-ids.g.json. Expose the project JSON dependency to SVO or provide a shared generated ID reader.

title: CMake regeneration drops paired Undertow root
body: An automatic CMake regeneration during the focused editor build discarded UNDERTOW_ROOT, causing sibling-kernel source lookup failure; the witness required manually re-exporting UNDERTOW_ROOT and VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE before every build. Preserve configured paired roots through regeneration.

title: Editor fixture needs generated content-id artifact
body: The product editor fixture lacked content/content-ids.g.json, so the resolver could not map authored material names to global handles; the witness required manually copying the generated core ID file into the fixture and adding a parent-path fallback. Pack setup should publish or validate this artifact.

title: Author bake witness has a cold generator path
body: The first author CLI bake had to cold-build the CLI and run the full wizard/codegen prebuild before the parity witness could execute. Publish a warmed, verified author-bake artifact or a documented lightweight bake setup for product parity checks.
